skill.name: ctx-insight
skill.description: Opens the hosted Context Mode Insight dashboard for engineering productivity analytics in the user's default browser.
skill.summary: Open Context Mode Insight and access engineering productivity analytics.
skill.author: mksglu

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally opens a fixed HTTPS dashboard, creating a transparent, low-severity external navigation risk. The remaining alerts are documentation false positives, and no malicious intent or prompt injection was found.

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks format the ctx_insight MCP tool name as Markdown. The line instructs an MCP call and contains no Ruby or shell command execution.
The MCP tool intentionally opens the fixed HTTPS dashboard in the user's browser. This is a disclosed external navigation side effect with limited risk.
The URL appears only in a quoted confirmation message for the user. This line does not initiate another network request or transmit data.
The line provides a manual browser fallback when automatic opening fails. It does not inspect the host, collect system details, or perform reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Engineering teams need a direct path to their Context Mode analytics. This skill opens the hosted Insight dashboard and reports its address.
actual_capabilities: Calls the ctx_insight MCP tool without parameters.
Opens the fixed Context Mode Insight URL in the default browser.
Displays the confirmation returned by the MCP tool.
Provides the dashboard URL for manual opening when needed.
Identifies the landing page as the source for sign-in and pricing details.
limitations: Requires the ctx_insight MCP tool to be available and configured.
Requires browser access and a network connection to reach the hosted dashboard.
Does not retrieve, analyze, or summarize dashboard metrics.
Does not manage accounts, authentication, subscriptions, or pricing.

use_cases.title: Review Team Productivity
use_cases.description: Open Insight to review productive rate, retry waste, blockers, and role-specific views.

use_cases.title: Inspect Personal Workflow
use_cases.description: Launch the dashboard before reviewing individual AI-assisted engineering activity.

use_cases.title: Support Analytics Access
use_cases.description: Provide the official dashboard address when automatic browser opening is unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Open Insight
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the Context Mode Insight dashboard.

prompt_templates.title: Open and Confirm
prompt_templates.prompt: Open Context Mode Insight and confirm the dashboard address.

prompt_templates.title: Provide a Browser Fallback
prompt_templates.prompt: Launch Insight, show the tool confirmation, and provide the official URL if my browser does not open.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Official Account Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Open Insight, display the exact tool response, and direct all sign-in and pricing questions to the official landing page.

output_examples.input: Open the Context Mode Insight dashboard.
Open Insight and give me the link if the browser does not launch.
output_examples.output: Insight opened at https://context-mode.com/insight. Open that address manually if the browser did not launch.

output_examples.input: Where can I check sign-in and pricing details?
output_examples.output: The Insight landing page at https://context-mode.com/insight is the official source for sign-in and pricing details.

best_practices: Invoke the skill only when the user requests the Insight dashboard.
Display the MCP tool confirmation before adding fallback guidance.
Use the official landing page for current sign-in and pricing information.
anti_patterns: Do not invent dashboard metrics that the skill does not retrieve.
Do not claim that browser opening succeeded without the tool confirmation.
Do not provide unofficial sign-in, account, or pricing instructions.

faq.question: What does this skill open?
faq.answer: It opens the hosted Context Mode Insight dashboard in the default browser.

faq.question: Which metrics are available in Insight?
faq.answer: The skill description lists productive rate, retry waste, blocker detection, and role-specific views.

faq.question: Does the skill analyze my metrics?
faq.answer: No. It opens the dashboard but does not retrieve or interpret dashboard data.

faq.question: What happens if my browser does not open?
faq.answer: The skill provides https://context-mode.com/insight so you can open the dashboard manually.

faq.question: Where are sign-in and pricing details?
faq.answer: Use the Insight landing page as the official source for current sign-in and pricing information.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the ctx_insight MCP tool, a default browser, and network access to the hosted dashboard.
